mission: Sequentially execute the four Momus-approved chargen fix plans (from the 2026-10-23 multi-family review) in the Highport repo.
plans_review_ledger: docs in .sisyphus/reviews/chargen-20261023/ledger.md; review verdicts in each plan's .reviews.md

operator_directives.execution_mode: sequential — one plan at a time, no parallel plan execution
operator_directives.orchestration_only: the orchestrator agent must NOT hand-implement code; dispatch implementation to worker agents (e.g. task category or /start-work in a worktree) and verify via the plan's Final Verification Wave
operator_directives.no_hurry: wall-clock is not a constraint; correctness and verification depth are
operator_directives.commit_push: atomic commits per logical unit, push to origin main (Tier A pre-authorized) after each plan's verification passes

order.rationale: security CRITICALs are live-exposed (WS token not doc-scoped, no Yjs write authz, X-User-Id impersonation); independent of the TermResolutionStep seam; executes before B so the shared export.ts seam flows C->B
surgical; settles authoritative-provenance display semantics that A and D build on
state-machine correctness foundation; rebases onto B's settled provenance semantics
largest TermResolutionStep.tsx churn; runs last to minimize merge surface

per_plan_protocol: 1. Re-read the plan file from disk; do not trust memory or summaries.

2. Heed the plan's .reviews.md notes (esp. fix-server-authz.reviews.md risks: apply command mutations to the LIVE Hocuspocus document, not only the DB; onChange not onUpdate; getOrCreateUser not getSessionUserId).
3. Work on a branch or worktree (agent/sisyphus/chargen-fix-<key>); rebase on main before starting if main moved.
4. Dispatch implementation to worker agent(s) following the plan's ordered todos exactly; test-first where the plan says so (RED commit before fix).
5. Run the plan's Final Verification Wave verbatim; record F#1..F#n verdicts (APPROVE/REJECT + one-clause evidence) in the plan's ## Execution Record — orchestrator writes these lines.
6. All F-boxes APPROVE required. On failure: dispatch repair to a worker (max 2 repair cycles), then stop and report if still failing.
7. Append execution-baseline line + Execution Record updates to the plan doc; merge to main (no-ff), push; update this state file (status: done + evidence pointers) and commit it.
8. Only then proceed to the next plan in order.
stop_conditions: All four plans done + pushed -> create suppression marker .sisyphus/execution/.chargen-fix-execution-complete and write a final report.
Any plan fails its verification wave after 2 repair cycles -> stop, leave state file marked, report to operator.
Operator interrupts -> honor immediately, update state file.
baseline_tests: chargen suites 45/45 green at 3a34945; must remain green after every plan
